description.id: Jelaskan utilitas dan opsi yang terdaftar
description.en: Explain a catalogued utility and option

records.minimum_access: verified bounded catalog index
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare exact indexed entry with pinned build source; no man or help spawn.

description.id: Daftar kemampuan Dictum
description.en: List Dictum capabilities

records.minimum_access: verified bounded catalog index
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare projected list against exact registry and profile; no spawn.

description.id: Informasi OS, kernel dan arsitektur
description.en: Show OS, kernel and architecture

records.minimum_access: read allowlisted OS metadata; no arbitrary files
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare fixture OS metadata and uname fields for same host identity.

description.id: Uptime dan rata-rata beban
description.en: Show uptime and load averages

records.minimum_access: read allowlisted uptime and load fields
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare same time/PID namespace and sampled uptime/load with bounded tolerance.

description.id: Cari socket yang mendengarkan berdasarkan port atau protokol
description.en: Find listening sockets by port or protocol

records.minimum_access: netlink socket diagnostics and allowlisted proc PID attribution; existing permissions only; report visibility limited/unknown
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare known lab listeners and PID visibility in intended network/PID namespaces; no active probe.

description.id: Daftar koneksi jaringan aktif
description.en: List active network connections

records.minimum_access: socket diagnostic visibility without added rights
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare seeded local socket states; normalize changing ephemeral state; no DNS.

description.id: Antarmuka, alamat dan status link
description.en: List interfaces, addresses and link states

records.minimum_access: read interface metadata in intended namespace
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare lab links and addresses with host snapshot; namespace mismatch is failure.

description.id: Tabel routing IP dan gateway lokal
description.en: Show local IP routes and default gateway

records.minimum_access: read route metadata in intended namespace
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare pinned lab routes and default gateway in intended namespace.

description.id: Konfigurasi resolver DNS aktif
description.en: Show active DNS resolver configuration

records.minimum_access: allowlisted resolv.conf and effective resolver metadata; resolve1 D-Bus interface candidate; no DNS request or proxy egress
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare controlled resolver configuration and effective mode; no queries or daemon proxy egress.

description.id: Usulkan kueri DNS
description.en: Propose a DNS query

records.minimum_access: resolver access not verified; network prohibited in product
records.host_equivalence_method: MVP proposal oracle only; compare exact DNS name, explicit initial A record type and NET effect; reject leading dash, at-sign or plus option-like operands, arbitrary resolver and non-A request; never run.

description.id: Usulkan ping maksimal empat paket
description.en: Propose ping with at most four packets

records.minimum_access: ICMP socket/capability may be required; no elevation
records.host_equivalence_method: MVP proposal oracle only; compare validated hostname or IP, count <=4 and NET effect; reject leading dash, at-sign or plus option-like operands and arbitrary flags; no traffic.

description.id: Panduan diagnosis konektivitas lokal
description.en: Guide local connectivity diagnosis

records.minimum_access: narrative guidance only; no OS access or invocation; no child operation IR
records.host_equivalence_method: Proposal oracle: bounded non-copyable narrative only; no argv, handler, child operation IR or host observation. ordered bounded local checks; no automatic probe or agent loop.

positive.expected: bounded non-copyable narrative; no child operation IR

description.id: Status, PID utama dan memori satu layanan
description.en: Show status, main PID and memory of one service

records.minimum_access: existing systemd read visibility; no new rights
records.host_equivalence_method: MVP proposal oracle: exact unit and current status, no D-Bus access.

description.id: Daftar layanan aktif sekarang
description.en: List currently active services

records.minimum_access: existing systemd read visibility; no new rights
records.host_equivalence_method: MVP proposal oracle: current active state, not enabled or historical.

description.id: Daftar layanan berstatus gagal sekarang
description.en: List currently failed services

records.minimum_access: existing systemd read visibility; no new rights
records.host_equivalence_method: MVP proposal oracle: currently failed vs since-boot history; no D-Bus access.

description.id: Daftar layanan yang diaktifkan saat boot
description.en: List services enabled for boot

records.minimum_access: existing unit metadata visibility; no new rights
records.host_equivalence_method: MVP proposal oracle: enabled state distinct from active.

description.id: Log jurnal satu unit dalam rentang waktu dan batas baris
description.en: Query one unit journal within time and line bounds

records.minimum_access: existing journal ACL only; system journal visibility may require root or existing adm/systemd-journal membership; never request elevation
records.host_equivalence_method: MVP proposal oracle: unit, half-open pinned time range and limit; no raw journal read.

positive.expected: pinned interval and bounded redacted projection

description.id: Log sistem prioritas err hingga emerg
description.en: Show system journal errors through emergency priority

records.minimum_access: existing journal ACL only; system journal visibility may require root or existing adm/systemd-journal membership; never request elevation
records.host_equivalence_method: MVP proposal oracle: err..emerg and pinned time window, never raw read.

description.id: Pesan kernel atau boot terakhir yang dapat diakses
description.en: Show accessible kernel or latest boot messages

records.minimum_access: existing journal ACL or kernel read rights only; no privilege/group change; limited visibility if unavailable
records.host_equivalence_method: MVP proposal oracle: current boot scope and visible messages, not privilege bypass.

description.id: Kapasitas dan penggunaan sistem berkas lokal
description.en: Show local filesystem capacity and usage

records.minimum_access: metadata of explicitly allowed local mounts; no remote mount probing
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare fixed local mount fixture capacities; exclude unapproved remote/sensitive mounts.

description.id: Penggunaan inode per sistem berkas
description.en: Show inode usage per filesystem

records.minimum_access: metadata of allowed local mounts; no remote mount probing
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare inode counts on seeded allowed local filesystem.

description.id: Urutkan subdirektori terbesar dalam root terotorisasi
description.en: Rank largest subdirectories under an authorized root

records.minimum_access: explicit root descriptor, traversal and readable entries; no automatic cwd authority
records.host_equivalence_method: Native descriptor-based fixture tree, allocated blocks, hardlink policy and depth; compare to independent lab oracle, not a du invocation by product.

positive.scenario: Lima direktori terbesar di root fixture

description.id: Daftar perangkat blok, partisi dan mount
description.en: List block devices, partitions and mount points

records.minimum_access: allowlisted sysfs and mount metadata, no device reads
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare lab block topology and allowed fields; no raw device/serial disclosure.

description.id: Daftar mount dan opsi yang boleh ditampilkan
description.en: List mounts and allowed mount options

records.minimum_access: allowlisted mount metadata; filter sensitive mount options
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare lab mount namespace and projected options; omit credentials.

description.id: Cari file berdasarkan nama, ekstensi atau waktu dalam root terotorisasi
description.en: Find files by name, extension or time under an authorized root

records.minimum_access: explicit root descriptor; bounded traversal, no link or mount escape
records.host_equivalence_method: Native descriptor-based traversal with literal names, Unicode, dash, half-open mtime bounds, sensitive canary and no mount escape; compare with fixed lab tree.

description.id: Cari teks literal dalam berkas teks terbatas
description.en: Search literal text within bounded text files

records.minimum_access: explicit root and allowlisted text files; no unrestricted recursion
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare seeded text including canary, binary/oversized files and literal pattern.

positive.scenario: Cari kata literal di root fixture

description.id: Metadata ukuran, izin, pemilik dan waktu file
description.en: Show file size, permissions, owner and timestamps

records.minimum_access: explicit file handle, no follow outside allowed root
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare pinned fixture inode metadata; deny symlink race/outside scope.

description.id: Periksa akses baca, tulis dan eksekusi target
description.en: Check read, write and execute access to a target

records.minimum_access: explicit target, current identity and ACL semantics; no actual write
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare lab ACL and effective identity without opening write or executing file.

negative.scenario: check another user's access by escalation

description.id: Tampilkan N baris awal atau akhir file teks non-sensitif
description.en: Show first or last N lines of a non-sensitive text file

records.minimum_access: explicit allowlisted text file; cap bytes and redact
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare fixed text with byte cap, last-line handling and canary; no raw secret.

description.id: Daftar isi arsip tanpa ekstraksi
description.en: List archive entries without extraction

records.minimum_access: explicit allowed archive; bounded decompression, no extraction
records.host_equivalence_method: Candidate archive listing command, never extraction; compare member metadata with independent fixture; malformed/link/traversal names remain data; spawn only hypothetical future effect.

description.id: Daftar proses dengan CPU tertinggi
description.en: List processes with highest CPU use

records.minimum_access: existing proc visibility, bounded sampling; no full cmdline
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare fixed process fixture and CPU sampling definition/window; tie-break PID.

description.id: Daftar proses dengan RSS tertinggi
description.en: List processes with highest RSS

records.minimum_access: existing proc visibility; no full cmdline
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare seeded process RSS snapshot and deterministic tie-break.

description.id: Cari PID dan detail aman berdasarkan nama proses
description.en: Find PID and allowed process details by name

records.minimum_access: existing proc visibility; no cmdline or environ
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare seeded exact comm names, duplicate names and hidepid.

description.id: Hierarki induk dan anak proses
description.en: Show parent-child process hierarchy

records.minimum_access: existing proc visibility; no full cmdline
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare seeded parent-child hierarchy, disappeared parents and depth cap.

description.id: Ringkasan RAM tersedia, cache dan swap
description.en: Summarize available RAM, cache and swap

records.minimum_access: read allowlisted memory metadata; no memory contents
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare known MemAvailable, cache and swap fixture; distinguish host from cgroup.

description.id: Arsitektur, core, thread dan frekuensi CPU
description.en: Show CPU architecture, cores, threads and frequency

records.minimum_access: allowlisted CPU metadata; no arbitrary sysfs read
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare fixed topology and frequency visibility; do not infer host topology from guest.

description.id: Periksa paket terpasang dan versinya
description.en: Check installed package and version

records.minimum_access: read local package database only
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare pinned dpkg database installed/not installed/version.

description.id: Cari paket dalam cache repositori lokal
description.en: Search packages in the local repository cache

records.minimum_access: read local cache; no update/download
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare literal query against pinned offline cache and stale/missing-cache outcome. Test regex metacharacters, backslash and leading dash, option-like operands and rejected flags; verify exact literal-match semantics against independent fixture oracle. If candidate grammar cannot guarantee literal behavior, BLOCKED/non-copyable; no cache update or download.

description.id: Daftar sesi login yang terlihat
description.en: List visible logged-in sessions

records.minimum_access: read permitted current utmp records only; no reverse lookup or NSS expansion; history deferred
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare synthetic utmp snapshot and redaction of remote origin; history separate.

description.id: UID, GID dan grup identitas saat ini
description.en: Show current UID, GID and group membership

records.minimum_access: numeric real/effective identity semantics to be verified; getuid/getgid/getgroups only; no name or NSS lookup
records.host_equivalence_method: Compare current numeric IDs under intended user namespace; no remote NSS.

positive.expected: numeric UID/GID/group IDs only; no NSS name lookup

negative.scenario: request NSS name or remote identity lookup

description.id: Panduan diagnosis disk penuh
description.en: Guide disk-full diagnosis

records.minimum_access: narrative guidance only; no OS access or invocation; no child operation IR
records.host_equivalence_method: Proposal oracle: bounded non-copyable narrative only; no argv, handler, child operation IR or host observation. capacity, inode and bounded explicit-root checks; no automatic deletion.

positive.expected: bounded non-copyable narrative; no child operation IR

description.id: Panduan diagnosis beban tinggi
description.en: Guide high-load diagnosis

records.minimum_access: narrative guidance only; no OS access or invocation; no child operation IR
records.host_equivalence_method: Proposal oracle: bounded non-copyable narrative only; no argv, handler, child operation IR or host observation. CPU/load, memory and I/O distinctions; no process kill.

positive.expected: bounded non-copyable narrative; no child operation IR

description.id: Panduan diagnosis layanan gagal mulai
description.en: Guide diagnosis of a service startup failure

records.minimum_access: narrative guidance only; no OS access or invocation; no child operation IR
records.host_equivalence_method: Proposal oracle: bounded non-copyable narrative only; no argv, handler, child operation IR or host observation. status, bounded logs and listener checks; no restart.

positive.expected: bounded non-copyable narrative; no child operation IR

description.id: Panduan diagnosis kegagalan DNS
description.en: Guide DNS resolution failure diagnosis

records.minimum_access: narrative guidance only; no OS access or invocation; no child operation IR
records.host_equivalence_method: Proposal oracle: bounded non-copyable narrative only; no argv, handler, child operation IR or host observation. config vs resolution; NET subproposal explicitly marked, no query.

positive.expected: bounded non-copyable narrative; no child operation IR

description.id: Usulkan restart satu layanan
description.en: Propose restarting one service

records.minimum_access: may require administrative authorization; no sudo or group change
records.host_equivalence_method: Proposal oracle only: exact unit, restart intent and warning; hard deny execute.

description.id: Usulkan reload konfigurasi satu layanan
description.en: Propose reloading one service configuration

records.minimum_access: may require administrative authorization; no sudo or group change
records.host_equivalence_method: Proposal oracle only: reload distinct from restart, not guaranteed disruption-free.

description.id: Usulkan ekstraksi ke subdirektori baru dengan pemeriksaan isi
description.en: Propose extraction into a new subdirectory with archive checks

records.minimum_access: explicit archive and new destination under authorized root; reject existing/unsafe target
records.host_equivalence_method: Proposal oracle only: inspect traversal/link entries and new destination; no extraction or safety guarantee.

positive.expected: structured proposal with warnings; safe aspirational and NOT VERIFIED

description.id: Usulkan pengarsipan file atau direktori ke tar.gz
description.en: Propose archiving a file or directory to tar.gz

records.minimum_access: explicit source and new destination; no overwrite, no sensitive traversal
records.host_equivalence_method: Proposal oracle only: explicit source/new archive, bounds and sensitive exclusion; no writes.

positive.scenario: Arsipkan root fixture ke tar.gz baru
